scope: Priority place operational + knowledge crawl: Dương Đông Market, Hàm Ninh, Bãi Sao, Bãi Khem.

topics.title: Chợ Dương Đông

claims.claim: The current Visit Phu Quoc destination listing places Chợ Dương Đông beside the Dương Đông river near the sea mouth and lists 21 Trần Phú as its address.
The current official destination listing shows opening hours 05:00-19:00.
Official destination material describes fresh seafood outside/around the market and daily goods, dried seafood and local products inside.
A current Visit Phu Quoc article recommends morning for the strongest fresh-seafood market activity. Treat this as practical editorial guidance rather than a formal operating rule.

Some official tourism pages still render the legacy Kiên Giang administrative wording in the street address. Store the place relation/canonical coordinates separately from display-address snapshots so administrative changes do not create duplicate entities.

topics.title: Hàm Ninh

claims.claim: Current official/local destination sources place Hàm Ninh on the east side of Phú Quốc at the foot of the Hàm Ninh mountain range, around 15-20 km from central Dương Đông.
Hàm Ninh is documented as a coastal community historically tied to fishing/seafood harvesting; tourism and seafood commerce now add to local livelihoods.

Government planning material identifies Hàm Ninh pier as infrastructure intended for transport, fishing and tourism services. This planning description should not be used as a live statement about the pier's exact present condition.
Current tourism articles often call Hàm Ninh a 'làng chài cổ', but this crawl has not yet found historical/archival evidence sufficient to assign a precise age or founding period.
The backlog requires a then/now treatment of the pier and village landscape; current crawl has not yet locked a reliable historical image/timeline set, so visual-change claims remain open.

topics.title: Bãi Sao

claims.claim: Current destination material places Bãi Sao in the southern-island travel context and describes it as a bay/crescent beach used for swimming and beach activities.

A current Visit Phu Quoc article explicitly describes Bãi Sao's infrastructure/services as historically underdeveloped and in need of improvement. This is editorial context, not a precise inventory of current facilities.

This crawl did not find a sufficiently authoritative current source for public parking, toilet access, fees or accessibility. These fields remain UNKNOWN rather than inferred from individual businesses.
Do not publish a fixed claim that Bãi Sao is calm/clear year-round. Beach quality and sea state are weather- and season-dependent and should connect to live/marine context.

topics.title: Bãi Khem

claims.claim: An Giang officially published approval information for the 1/2000 Bãi Khem - Mũi Ông Đội subdivision plan under Decision 1635/QĐ-UBND dated 22/10/2025, covering about 128.68 ha.

The Phú Quốc 2040 planning direction describes coastal parks linked to public bathing beaches and requires connections to public coastal space without closed gates/fences; the approved subdivision also includes public sea-square/open-space concepts.

Planning intent for public beach/open space does not by itself prove that every beach segment or approach is physically accessible to a non-resort visitor today. Current public approach, parking and access friction require field/current verification.

Resort-fronted services and facilities are separate from public-beach access. Do not treat resort pools, loungers, toilets, parking or restaurants as public amenities without explicit permission/fee data.
The area has active/current planning and development documentation, so access/service information may change and should carry a verified_at timestamp.
